display_title: Guy in the Next Room With NTR
description:
Sujin Song and Jinho Lee, married for one year, have a difficult time with their sexual relationship. After sharing a drink and becoming drunk, Sujin ends up having sex with Hyungjun. This episode, so different from her experiences with her husband, turns out to be thrilling for her...
